facts.fact: 表兄 Simon 被牛津停学（rusticated），父母要他离开伦敦、等复学期间住到主角家，他拒绝回爱尔兰。
facts.anchor: Apparently he’s been rusticated and his parents want him out of London until they can get him reinstated

facts.fact: 布莱克福德伯爵想起诉 Simon 诽谤他的儿子 Orson，称书中是高度可辨认的肖像、恶毒的谎言。
facts.anchor: He wants to sue Simon for libeling his son Orson

facts.fact: 诽谤诉讼已在 Orson 本人坚持下撤回。
facts.anchor: The suit’s been withdrawn, at Orson’s insistence

facts.fact: 父亲斥责 Olivia：自从 Irikos 离开后只会闷闷不乐、糟蹋自己，结婚前得找点事做。
facts.anchor: You’ve done nothing but mope and waste yourself since Irikos left

facts.fact: Olivia 在餐桌上结结巴巴地提出：她在 Carn Kerys 遇见的女孩 Tamsin Griggs 应来家里和她一起受教。
Mrs. Fletcher 当面翻旧账：Anna Griggs 救过父亲的女儿 Olivia 的命，他当年许诺她日后有需要必帮；父亲也回忆当年妻子在 Madron 农场突然临产，是 Griggs 救了 Olivia 母女两条命。
Mrs. Fletcher 说出：Anna Griggs 两年前去世、丈夫更早离世，Tamsin 是与姨妈同住的孤儿。
facts.anchor: Anna Griggs died two years back, and her husband before that

facts.fact: 父亲拍板：明天开车去 St. Ives 给 Simon 打电话；Simon 若不同意，此事作罢。
facts.anchor: I’ll drive to St. Ives tomorrow and call him. If he doesn’t agree, that’s the end of it, Livvie.
